description: NaOHH₂O crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaOHH₂O sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two H and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.46 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two H and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.40 Å) and one longer (2.48 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.42 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.02 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.02 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.01 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.02 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one H atom.
